supersedingDecision.note: Cratis/AI#187's closure recorded that generatedDistribution, githubRelease, canary, and autoPromote are no longer implemented: every one of them was behavior of .github/workflows/release-approved-ai-profiles.yml and distribution-generated-update.yml, both deleted by Cratis/AI#266. The booleans below are deliberately left as they are because distribution/release-request.schema.json pins generatedDistribution, githubRelease, npmPublish, and canary as const true, so correcting them means redesigning the S10 release-request model - explicitly a separate, larger decision per Cratis/AI#264 and out of scope for Cratis/AI#258. Read this block, not the booleans, for what is implemented today.
supersedingDecision.recoveryNote: The recovery text below describes deleting a draft GitHub release and closing a generated index pull request. Neither exists any more. npm publication remains immutable by construction and runs on exactly one label-gated path.

recovery.beforeNpmPublication: Delete the draft GitHub release, close the generated index pull request, and delete its branch.
recovery.afterNpmPublication: Keep the immutable npm package, draft release, and index pull request for explicit recovery; never claim the npm version was rolled back.
recovery.subscriberUpdates: Disabled until Cratis/Workflows#73 is implemented and canaried.
recovery.marketplaces: Manual publisher-account and vendor-review handoff remains tracked by Cratis/AI#147.
